title: Chapter 188 New Lineup Of Reinforcements
content:
Chapter 188 New Lineup Of Reinforcements

In Wu Qing's opinion, the more arrogant the Tengu tribe is in public, the better. The Zerg tribe will find an opportunity to beat them up in the future, which will be justified in public opinion.

When the Zerg tribe develops, the Tengu tribe will always be disgusting, and Wu Qing can't stand it. He will always find an opportunity to drive them away.

"Let's go! Let's go and get your fiancée back, take your family, and settle down in the Zerg Daxia first!"

"According to the atmosphere of your tribe, if you encounter such a thing, you will be killed sooner or later if you continue to stay here!"

Wu Qing said this heart-breaking words loudly through the captain of the Silkworm Knights, making the Tengu tribe members who felt a little ashamed at the scene feel ashamed.

But Wu Qing was telling the truth, and they were powerless to refute it.

"The Tengu tribe has indeed become more and more outrageous over the years. Many of their territories outside have lost the demeanor of a big tribe!"

"There are all kinds of messes. This time, we encountered a big tribe that didn't give us face. This is a complete loss of face, alas!"

"Now, the hatred between the two tribes has been formed. They are so close to each other. Don't fight in the future!"

"I heard that if it weren't for the sudden appearance of the Zerg tribe, the Tengu tribe's territory here would have been occupied by the evil god camp!"

"The two tribes originally had conflicts, and now they are tit-for-tat, which makes sense!"

"Alas, there are strong enemies outside and no unity inside. The prospects of our local camp are worrying!"

"It is normal to have conflicts. The evil god camp will also have conflicts, so there is no need to be too pessimistic!"

"..."

Accompanied by the whispers of the onlookers, a Tiancan Knight grabbed Gou Shu and asked him to lead the way to get people.

Gou Shu knew that what the Tiancan Knight said made sense. He was completely disappointed with the Tengu tribe through what happened to him, and no longer trusted the promises made by the Tengu tribe.

Gou Shu first directed the Silkworm Knight to the mansion of the mastermind behind this matter. His fiancée was taken away by someone, and now that he has the ability, he must rescue her first. The rest of the things are not something he can participate in, and can only be left to the Zerg to deal with.

The Silkworm Knight's speed is not very fast, leaving time for the other party to prepare. If the other party still makes small moves, Wu Qing doesn't mind killing him in this city!

If a fight really breaks out, even if it is night now, Wu Qing will also load the transport host with the fortune array map and bring a special team to beat him upside down in this large city of the Tengu tribe!

Wu Qing hopes that such a thing will not happen!

Not long after, the Silkworm Knight arrived at the other party's mansion.

Behind them, there are also some people from various forces and organizations. These people have strong backgrounds. They have noticed the extraordinaryness of the Zerg and began to pay attention to the Zerg's every move and collect relevant information.

The other party did not make any small moves, and there is no need for the Silkworm Knight to threaten again. Someone in the mansion will send Gou Shu's fiancée out.

Unlike Wu Qing's imagination of forcibly abducting a woman, the Tengu woman who was sent out looked very young and was dressed in training clothes.

When she was sent outside the mansion, she was confused when she saw the Heavenly Silkworm Knight and Gou Shu.

"Is it her?"

"It's her!"

Although Gou Shu had never met his fiancée formally, he had seen her from a distance several times and knew her.

Wu Qing possessed the Heavenly Silkworm Knight, dismounted and personally communicated with Gou Shu's young fiancée, and then he figured out the whole story.

It turned out that the mastermind behind the scenes was not interested in Gou Shu's fiancée's beauty, but her cultivation talent. According to her, when she succeeded in cultivation, she would be sent to a big man in the tribe as a personal guard.

Gou Shu and his fiancée were both born in ordinary families. It was actually quite good to have such an opportunity. By chance, she was engaged and was about to get married, and the person who was interested in her qualifications did not take other people's lives seriously at all, and directly dealt with Gou Shu.

Wu Qing didn't know what was going on, and he wasn't interested in knowing. It was a good thing that the people were fine. He asked the Silkworm Knight to take Gou Shu and his fiancée home.

When Gou Shu and his fiancée returned home, the two families were naturally happy. After learning the inside story, they also understood the seriousness of the matter.

The two families discussed together and finally followed Gou Shu's suggestion to settle down in the Great Xia Territory of the Zerg Clan. With the relationship with the Lord of the Great Xia Territory, life would not be too difficult.

If they didn't leave the Tengu Clan's sphere of influence, even if the parties involved in this incident didn't dare to do it again, the people below would take their own initiative, and their lives would definitely not be easy. The family was broken and the people died, which was a better ending.

That night, the two families packed up their belongings and squeezed into one family. Under the protection of the Silkworm Knight, they spent an unforgettable night.

Today, the Silkworm Knight has almost created momentum. When Wu Qing sends people to pick up the two families tomorrow, he can make some more things happen, and the Silkworm Knight's work will be easier.

In the past, Wu Qing read the Investiture of the Gods and fairy-tale martial arts novels. In order to avoid being involved in cause and effect, the people in the novels either stayed in seclusion or sealed off their own mountain gates. The masters also did not allow their disciples to go out.

What they feared was being involved in cause and effect, being entangled in calamity, and leaving in calamity.

The Zerg now actively entered the world, and the Heavenly Silkworm Knight was the pioneer of entering the world. Entering the world, of course, involves cause and effect. For Wu Qing, the more cause and effect the Zerg is involved in, the better.

No matter good or bad cause and effect, as long as the cause and effect are involved with the Zerg, the system can harvest Qi resources from the other party. The deeper the cause and effect, the greater the system's harvest.

If the Zerg kills the other party directly like on the battlefield, the greatest harvest can be obtained.

Because of this, if possible, the Zerg would better get involved in everything and be deeply involved in the cause and effect of others. Even if others accidentally fall to death, the system can obtain a lot of Qi resources.

The more the cause and effect of the Zerg are involved, the greater the reputation, and the faster they can develop.

That night, Gou Shu and his two families, who were protected by the Silkworm Knight, lived a peaceful life, but other places in the city were not peaceful.

The high-profile behavior of the Zerg today attracted the attention of many forces. They certainly would not believe that the Zerg was just to help an unknown person from the Tengu tribe to vent their anger.

The news related to the Zerg was collected and sorted overnight and spread through various means. The Zerg has truly entered the attention of some forces in this world.

Many people in the city are waiting for the Zerg's follow-up actions tomorrow. Everyone thinks that this matter is not over yet. At least the Zerg's Silkworm Knight originally came with a mission.

...

Wu Qing's consciousness returned to the main body. Seeing that the system's Qi resources were constantly increasing, he was very satisfied with the performance of the Silkworm Knight. He was very much looking forward to a large number of Silkworm Knights entering the hinterland of the local race camp.

Today, the Silkworm Knight took advantage of the conflict over Gou Shu's incident to make his debut. Wu Qing will use this force to make another show tomorrow to continue to deepen everyone's impression of the Zerg.

After thinking about it, Wu Qing chose to upgrade another transport host.

Tomorrow, a transport host will follow the third batch of reinforcements to support the Naga tribe and go to the Naga territory. The Zerg helped the Naga tribe win a decisive battle. Given the character of the Naga tribe, there will be no shortage of gifts for gratitude tomorrow.

Sending a transport host over is to transport the Naga tribe's gifts of gratitude.

And tomorrow, Wu Qing will go to the Tengu tribe's big city to pick up Gou Shu and his family, and he also wants to send a transport host over.

The appearance of the transport host is really domineering, and it is an aerial transport creature. With its powerful strength, it is enough to cause a sensation, which is far more shocking than sending a team of Zerg troops to greet them!

From a practical point of view, the transport host is fast and the escort personnel are safe and comfortable. It is the best choice for tasks such as long-distance transportation.

Sending a transport host to pick up people is a two-pronged approach. Wu Qing consumed resources and evolved the second transport host of the Zerg.

As the Silkworm Knight walks, there will be more and more opportunities to use the transport host.

Wu Qing added a transport host. He thought that there was still a batch of luck beads sent by the Naga tribe that had not been absorbed and converted into gas resources. There will be a large number of luck beads coming in tomorrow. This is considered to be a surplus of food, and he is confident.

Because of the lack of manpower, the Zerg wasted so many resources in vain on the Naga battlefield today. It would be fine if they didn't see it, but Wu Qing felt very sad if he saw it but didn't get it.

In order to prevent this from happening again, Wu Qing is going to form a Zerg reinforcement that can fight independently to support the Naga tribe in the battle.

The Zerg fights itself, taking down all the enemies it sees, and treating the enemies it doesn't see as non-existent, out of sight, out of mind.

Wu Qing decided that in addition to 300,000 Zerg Zerglings and 1,000 Blasting Swarms, the third batch of reinforcements tomorrow would include 100 Hydralisks, 3,000 Roaches, and 500 Destroyers.

Together with the tens of thousands of Zerglings in the Naga territory, the total number of Zerg troops supporting the Naga territory will exceed 350,000.

With the addition of Hydralisks, Roaches, and Destroyers, this Zerg reinforcement is a real Zerg main combat force, and its combat power is not at the same level as the original pure Zerg Zerg Zerg force.

If the Zerg is in this lineup to attack the Demon Citadel, they don't even need to use Blasting Swarms, and can easily defeat it at a very low cost.

500 Destroyers are much more useful than the siege weapons made by the Goblins that the Naga purchased.

With the coordinated combat of Roaches, the Zerg Zerg Zerg will greatly reduce casualties, and with the long-range support of Hydralisks, the best partner, the effect is better than the Feather Clan Cavalry Archers.

Tomorrow, the third batch of reinforcements will go to the Naga territory with this lineup to test the effect. If the combat effect is good and the benefits are large enough, Wu Qing will continue to send troops.

As long as there are resources, the Zerg territory does not have to worry about insufficient troops. If there are enough gas resources, the Zerg can immediately send a strong army and conquer the ghoul territory in the underground world.

After arranging the lineup of reinforcements for tomorrow, Wu Qing will continue to understand the development of the Zerg territory through the information summarized by the Queen of the Zerg, and understand the intelligence of the Alliance, the Goblin Chamber of Commerce, the Tengu, the Naga, the Bear Goblin, the Demon Clan and other parties.

Wu Qing must be aware of these situations.

With the development of the Zerg, more and more things happen. If there is no Queen of the Zerg, it is unknown how many management talents need to be cultivated to support the rapid development of Wu Qing's power.
